headline: Mooring County Erupts Anew as Stlican Shelf Flares
war_summary: Since our last edition the storm has broadened. Mooring County has come alive again after its morning lull: fifteen base actions on the day, ten inside six hours and three in the last two, with Gravekeeper's Holdfast and The Cut the hottest points while the Wardens still hold eleven of twelve posts. The Weathered Expanse remains the furnace — thirty-seven actions on the day, six in the final two hours, the last logged as this edition closed, Crow's Nest and Frostmarch still the storm centers, the line frozen at six Wardens to three Colonials. Both fronts now bleed at more than a thousand casualties an hour. Stlican Shelf has newly flared: three actions in two hours about Fort Hoarfrost, where the Colonials hold five bases to four. Stonecradle, silent since morning, carries the day's heaviest toll at nearly twenty-three thousand, the Colonials ahead eight bases to one. Callahan's Passage has logged no base actions in a day and Farranac Coast's base war has been silent since midnight, yet casualty rates climb in both. The Nevish Line and the Linn of Mercy have gone quiet. It is the 356th day of the war; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
